CVE-2026-97054 is a Go net/http flaw: an HTTP/1 server that uses MaxBytesReader can panic if its handler reads the body while writing the response header. It is in the Go standard library compiled into /usr/local/bin/gosu in postgres:18-alpine. gosu only drops privileges and then runs postgres; it serves no HTTP, so the flaw is not reachable. Fixed in Go 1.26.11 and 1.27.4, but no postgres image ships gosu built on either yet. Owner 47a, 2026-11-19: 14 days.

CVE-2026-97054 is a Go net/http flaw: an HTTP/1 server that uses MaxBytesReader can panic if its handler reads the body while writing the response header. It is in the Go standard library compiled into /usr/bin/ollama in ollama/ollama:0.40.17 (built with go1.26.10, checked 2026-11-21). Orbit runs Ollama only under the optional ai profile, on the internal network, with no published port (ADR-0025), so only Orbit's app can reach it and the worst case is a crash and restart. Fixed in Go 1.26.11 and 1.27.4, but no Ollama image ships a build on either yet. Owner 47a, 2026-11-19: 14 days. Checked 2026-11-24 inside 0.40.18: still go1.26.10.

CVE-2026-86144 is a libxml2 flaw, in Alpine's libxml2 2.13.9-r2 in postgres:18-alpine and clamav/clamav:1.5.5. Fixed in Alpine 2.13.9-r3, but neither image has been rebuilt with it: on 2026-11-21 both pinned digests are still the newest upstream builds of their tags (sidecar-pins check). ClamAV reads untrusted files, so this is the one to clear first; remove this entry as soon as a rebuilt image is pinned. Owner 91a, 2026-11-21: 14 days.

CVE-2026-97054 is a Go net/http flaw: an HTTP/1 server that uses MaxBytesReader can panic if its handler reads the body while writing the response header. It is in the Go standard library compiled into /usr/bin/pebble in apache/tika:4.2.0-2-full. The image's entrypoint runs Java (TikaServerCli) directly and never starts pebble, so the flaw is not reachable. Fixed in Go 1.26.11 and 1.27.4, but on 2026-11-21 the pinned digest is still the newest build of 4.2.0-full (tagged 4.2.0-2-full since; the same image, pebble on go1.27.3, checked 2026-11-24) and no newer Tika release exists. Owner 91a, 2026-11-21: 14 days.

deploymentImageReferences.rule: A deployment must run an immutable digest. A mutable tag may be resolved to a digest; it may never be deployed.
